system_description.narrative_title: China-driven Competition Reshaping Asia's Economy, Tech, and Security
system_description.narrative_summary: A single, dominant narrative ties together headlines about China's expanding economic reach, strategic industrial policy, and increasing military activity, and the consequent regional and global responses. This open system links shifts in Chinese domestic demand and industrial strategy (autos, chips, supply chains, Arctic routes) with regional security moves (naval drills, shipbuilding, allied exercises), corporate relocation and investment decisions, and policy measures (tariffs, tax reforms, export controls). Feedback loops—sanctions/decoupling, industrial subsidies, and militarisation—amplify reconfiguration of supply chains, defence industries, and capital flows across the Indo‑Pacific and beyond.
system_description.scope: Actors and processes in the Asia‑Pacific economic-security complex: nation-states (China, U.S., South Korea, Japan, Taiwan, Vietnam, Australia, Indonesia, North Korea), private firms (auto makers, chip firms, shipbuilders, miners, space/telecom companies), supply chains (autos, semiconductors, rare earths, shipping routes), capital and trade flows, defence posture and exercises, cyber capabilities and policy actions (tariffs, export controls, tax reform). Includes market reactions (equities, investments) and industrial policy responses.
system_description.super_system: The global geopolitical-economic order (U.S.-led liberal security and trade architecture and the integrated global market)
adjacent_subsystems: Global technology and semiconductor supply chains (chips, memory, AI ecosystems)
Maritime and naval security architecture in the Indo‑Pacific
Global automotive and EV manufacturing and logistics networks
Global financial and investment flows (capital allocation, sanctions and trade policy responses)

variables.name: Industrial subsidy intensity
variables.description: The aggregate magnitude and tempo of state-directed financial supports (grants, tax breaks, loans) aimed at domestic industries measured on a continuous scale.

variables.name: Supply chain geographic concentration
variables.description: The degree to which critical supply chains (components, raw materials, finished goods) are spatially concentrated in a limited set of locations or corridors.

variables.name: Cross-border trade flow volume
variables.description: The continuous rate and value of goods and services moving across borders in the region, measured as an ongoing transactional flow.

variables.name: Cross-border capital flow volume
variables.description: The magnitude and velocity of cross-border financial investment and disinvestment into regional productive assets and markets.

variables.name: Corporate relocation rate
variables.description: The pace at which production capacity, R&D, or corporate operations are moved between jurisdictions or sites.

variables.name: Semiconductor production capacity
variables.description: The installed and operational wafer/fab output capability measured continuously as aggregate chip production potential in the region.

variables.name: Export control stringency
variables.description: The strictness and enforceability of regulatory controls limiting outbound transfers of technologies, components, or know‑how.

variables.name: Regional militarization level
variables.description: The overall scale and posture of military capabilities and presence in the maritime and continental domain, measured as a continuous intensity.

variables.name: Naval activity frequency
variables.description: The tempo and recurrence rate of naval maneuvers, joint exercises, and maritime transits in contested or strategic waters.

variables.name: Defense procurement demand
variables.description: The ongoing rate of demand for military platforms, shipbuilding, and defense systems as measured by procurement flows and contracts.

variables.name: Rare earth supply dependence
variables.description: The share of critical minerals and rare earth inputs sourced from a limited supplier set, expressed as a continuous dependency ratio.

variables.name: Shipping and route diversification
variables.description: The extent to which logistics and maritime trade are distributed across alternative routes and chokepoints (including polar and secondary corridors).

variables.name: Cyber operation frequency
variables.description: The rate and intensity of offensive cyber operations and intrusions targeting infrastructure, companies, or states in the region.

variables.name: Investor sentiment volatility
variables.description: The short‑term variability in market participants' risk assessments and confidence about regional economic and technological prospects.

variables.name: Technology capability gap
variables.description: The continuous measured difference in critical technological capabilities (advanced manufacturing, AI, semiconductors, space) between competing actors or regions.

variables.name: Policy fragmentation in trade and tech
variables.description: The degree of divergence and inconsistency across jurisdictions in trade, export, investment, and technology policy frameworks.

catalysts.title: China–Indonesia naval drills east of Taiwan
catalysts.description: Planned joint Chinese–Indonesian naval exercises in waters east of Taiwan that are likely to raise maritime tensions and activity in the short term.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "China, Indonesia navies to hold drills in sensitive waters to east of Taiwan"; Taiwan condemned planned drill.

catalysts.title: Taiwan naval war games and coast guard arming
catalysts.description: Taiwan's wartime drills and moves to 'weaponize' its coast guard signal an ongoing increase in maritime preparedness and operations.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "Taiwan holds naval drill during war games"; "Taiwan Weaponizes Coast Guard to Prepare for Battle With China."

catalysts.title: South Korea $3.5B chip fund launch
catalysts.description: Launch and initial deployment of a $3.5 billion South Korean semiconductor fund to accelerate hub development and subsidize capacity.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: "South Korea to launch $3.5 billion chip fund, speed development of semiconductor hubs."

catalysts.title: SK Hynix AI-driven capacity buildout
catalysts.description: Large-scale SK Hynix investment program to expand wafer and memory capacity driven by AI demand, accelerating regional chip output.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: "An inside look at SK Hynix $720 billion AI-fueled buildout that's taking over South Korea."

catalysts.title: Ford shifts some Lincoln production to U.S.
catalysts.description: Ford's plan to move production of some Lincoln models out of China and increase U.S. output through 2030, prompting supply-chain moves.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "EXCLUSIVE: Automaker Ford to move production of some Lincoln models from China to US"; "Ford says it's increasing Lincoln production in the U.S. in 2030."

catalysts.title: Risk of renewed Chinese rare‑earth export controls
catalysts.description: Fears and market moves point to possible fresh Chinese export restrictions on niche rare earths, with knock‑on supply concentration effects.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "Price of niche rare earth jumps on fears of renewed Chinese export controls"; "US backs Australian rare earth miner to cut out China."

catalysts.title: Expansion of China's 'Ice Silk Road' Arctic shipping
catalysts.description: Continued use and promotion of Arctic shipping corridors by China to bypass chokepoints, diversifying routes and altering trade patterns.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: "China bypasses shipping chokepoints with ‘Ice Silk Road’ through Arctic".

catalysts.title: Surge in AI‑driven cyber operations
catalysts.description: Reports of AI-enabled attacks and state‑linked hacking campaigns signal rising autonomous cyber operations targeting regional actors.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "China-linked hackers hit Taiwan in unprecedented ‘autonomous’ AI cyber attack"; "North Korean hacking group builds AI tools."

catalysts.title: U.S. push to block advanced chips reaching sanctioned Chinese firms
catalysts.description: Political and regulatory efforts in the U.S. to further restrict advanced semiconductor exports to targeted Chinese entities, tightening controls regionally.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: "Key Republican urges US to stop any advanced chips from reaching sanctioned Chinese firms."

catalysts.title: South Korea future‑tech push (moon by 2030)
catalysts.description: South Korea's unveiled future-technology projects and moon-landing target accelerate R&D and investment in high‑tech capabilities across industries.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "South Korea unveils future technology projects, targets moon landing by 2030."
